== Notes ==
* Expect the affected foes to deal 33% less damage on average.
* Like blocking, chances to miss [[effect stacking|stack]] multiplicatively, not additively. A foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and [[Price of Failure]] has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks, not 75%.
* Good synergy with skills like [[Spiteful Spirit]] and [[Empathy]] in [[normal mode]]; the increased attack speed will trigger these more often.
* Enemies in [[hard mode]] already attack 25% faster, so this skill's additional increase [[effect stacking|will be less effective]]. Expect this skill to decrease the damage of hard mode foes by 42%.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] is similar to [[Images of Remorse]].
